free_tier.stated: Free: USD 0, 'Light quota to code with agents', limited model availability, Unlimited inline edits, Unlimited Tab completions
free_tier.notes: the free tier's agent allowance is the word 'light' and no number. The two components with a number are the two that are unlimited, which is the inverse of what a reader needs

record.interface_detail: a web application, a desktop client, a command-line client and a REST API: docs.devin.ai documents the Devin API at https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/*, reached with a service-user key, and Devin CLI, a local command-line coding agent
record.tooling: a script reaches the agent through the Devin API with a service-user key (Authorization: Bearer), creating a session at POST https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/ORG/sessions; Devin CLI runs a local command-line agent from the same vendor
record.chaining: the agent allowance is the scarce link: it is discretionary and unpublished, so it cannot be sized before it is spent

limits.value: the Free plan's agent quota is described as 'Light quota to code with agents' with no number; Pro 'Increased quotas', Max 'Significantly higher quotas'

record.limits_note: no plan on the ladder states a countable allowance for agent work. Inline edits and Tab completions are stated as unlimited on Free, which is a documented absence and not a limit. Paid plans refresh their allowance on a daily and weekly basis; no window is stated for the Free plan's light quota
record.binding_note: the unpublished agent quota binds before anything else, because it is discretionary and there is no number to design against

identity_cost.detail: the paid ladder is bought with a card; the Free plan is USD 0 and the page does not state a card at signup

record.confidence_note: the ladder, the prices and the Free plan's four stated features are quoted from devin.ai/pricing read 2026-10-22 at 200, 582848 bytes.

evidence.proved: the full ladder: Free USD 0 'Light quota to code with agents', Unlimited inline edits, Unlimited Tab completions; Pro USD 20 a month; Max USD 200 a month; Teams USD 80 a month for the team plan plus USD 40 a month per full dev seat. The page is 582848 bytes at HTTP 200 and carries a 'Compare Plans Free $0/month Pro $20/month Max $200/month Team $80/month' row
the Free plan is unchanged: a light agent quota with no number, unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions
evidence.quote: The Free plan includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits, and unlimited Tab completions.

evidence.proved: the paid-plan allowance has a daily and a weekly window; the Free plan's window is not stated
evidence.quote: Each paid plan comes with a usage allowance that refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis.

evidence.proved: the Free plan is still USD 0 with a light, unnumbered agent quota
evidence.quote: The Free plan includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits, and unlimited Tab completions.

evidence.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.

record.notes: The page was live the whole time: a raw fetch returns 200 with 582848 bytes and the full ladder. The distinction the verdict vocabulary exists to carry is dead versus paid-only versus free-with-a-discretionary-allowance, and this is the third. The free agent quota is the word 'light', so the row is qualifies-with-caveat rather than qualifies. Whether a script can drive it is not established: the page advertises a desktop client and no API key.
